forms.title: Bhutan Immigration Services Portal (Department of Immigration) — tourist visa and Indian entry permit
forms.stoppedAt: The application opens only after signing up for an account (step 1 of the published process); only the public home page and its FAQs were read.

steps.name: Create Account
notices: Please sign up to apply for immigration services

steps.name: Complete Application
notices: Ensure information and document requirements are completed
For Tourist ● A digital copy of your passport. The passport must be valid for six months from the intended date of departure from Bhutan. ● A recent digital passport size photograph.

For Tourist (permit) ● A digital copy of your passport or voter ID card. Those under the age of 18 can use a birth certificate or passport and must be accompanied by a legal guardian. ● A recent digital passport size photograph.
